events.title: GPL version 1 published
events.summary: The [Free Software] Foundation published [GPL] v1 in February 1989 — the [copyleft] license behind Linux, [GCC], and thousands of projects.
events.about: [GPL] requires derivatives to stay open — influencing corporate open-source policies and dual-licensing business models. Every developer who ships [GPL] code inherits Stallman's legal framework.

narrative.whyChosen: [GPL] is the legal backbone of the [free software] ecosystem.
narrative.whyImportant: [Copyleft] ensured improvements returned to the community.
narrative.problemSolved: Permissive licenses let companies take open code proprietary without contributing back.
